name: CMI Tessellate Cube Open 2018
information:
Online registrations will be done on WCA with payment at the given link. This is the only acceptable form of online registration. Registration is Free for all CMI students. Please mention your ID number in the comments while registering as proof. 

There will be NO On-Spot Registration at the venue. You must have a WCA ID (except new competitors) and a valid email. Please check the Payment Tab for all details. 

Reporting Desk shall be open 8:00-8:30am for 3x3x3Blindfold and FMC and 8:30-9:00am for other events. Those not arriving on time may not be allowed to do their solves.

Please bring govt./employer/educational photo ID card for institutional documentation.
Lunch coupons can be purchased at Reporting Desk.
